summary_1line: Duryodhana refuses to give the Pandavas any land; Krishna rebukes him by recounting his injustices, but Duryodhana angrily storms out.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna, eyes red with anger, stands in the Kuru assembly rebuking Duryodhana while elders like Bhishma and Drona watch in tense silence.
Duryodhana rises like an enraged serpent from his throne and storms out of the royal court, ignoring the gathered elders and Krishna.
